      (task.completedAt !== undefined && typeof task.completedAt !== "string")) fail("malformed database");
    if (task.id > maxId) maxId = task.id;
  }
  const ids = tasks.map((task: any) => task.id);
  if (new Set(ids).size !== ids.length) fail("malformed database");
  const nextId = raw.nextId === undefined ? maxId + 1 : raw.nextId;
  if (nextId <= maxId) fail("malformed database");
  return { tasks: tasks as Task[], nextId };
}

function save(database: Database): void {
  const temporary = `${file}.tmp-${process.pid}-${randomBytes(8).toString("hex")}`;
  try {
    writeFileSync(temporary, JSON.stringify(database, null, 2) + "\n", { encoding: "utf8", flag: "wx" });
    renameSync(temporary, file);
  } catch (error) {
    try { unlinkSync(temporary); } catch { /* best effort cleanup */ }
    throw error;
  }
}

function options(args: string[]): Map<string, string> {
  const result = new Map<string, string>();
  for (let i = 0; i < args.length; i++) {
    const arg = args[i];
    if (!arg.startsWith("--")) fail(`unexpected argument: ${arg}`);
    if (result.has(arg)) fail(`duplicate flag: ${arg}`);
    const value = args[++i];
    if (value === undefined || value.startsWith("--")) fail(`missing value for ${arg}`);
    result.set(arg, value);
  }
  return result;
}

function onlyFlags(values: Map<string, string>, allowed: string[]): void {
  for (const key of values.keys()) if (!allowed.includes(key)) fail(`unknown flag: ${key}`);
}

function taskById(database: Database, value: string): Task {
  if (!/^\d+$/.test(value) || Number(value) < 1) fail("invalid task id");
  const task = database.tasks.find((candidate) => candidate.id === Number(value));
  if (!task) fail("task not found");
  return task;
}

function run(argv: string[]): unknown {
  const command = argv[0];
  if (!command) fail("missing command");
  const database = load();
  if (command === "add") {
    const flags = options(argv.slice(1));
    onlyFlags(flags, ["--title", "--tags", "--due"]);
    const title = flags.get("--title");
    if (title === undefined || !title.trim()) fail("title is required");
    const due = flags.get("--due");
    if (due !== undefined && !isDate(due)) fail("invalid due date");
    const tags = [...new Set((flags.get("--tags") || "").split(",").map((tag) => tag.trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean))];
    const task: Task = { id: database.nextId++, title: title.trim(), status: "open", createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), tags };
    if (due !== undefined) task.due = due;
    database.tasks.push(task);
    save(database);
    return task;
  }
  if (command === "list") {
    const flags = options(argv.slice(1));
    onlyFlags(flags, ["--status", "--tag", "--overdue"]);
    const status = flags.get("--status");
    const tag = flags.get("--tag");
    const overdue = flags.get("--overdue");
    if (status !== undefined && status !== "open" && status !== "done") fail("invalid status");
    if (overdue !== undefined && !isDate(overdue)) fail("invalid overdue date");
    return database.tasks.filter((task) =>
      (status === undefined || task.status === status) &&
      (tag === undefined || task.tags.includes(tag.trim().toLowerCase())) &&
      (overdue === undefined || (task.status === "open" && task.due !== undefined && task.due < overdue))
    ).sort((a, b) => a.id - b.id);
  }
  if (command === "done") {
    if (argv.length !== 2) fail("task id is required");
    const flags = options(argv.slice(2));
    if (flags.size) fail("unexpected flag");
    const task = taskById(database, argv[1]);
    if (task.status === "open") { task.status = "done"; task.completedAt = new Date().toISOString(); save(database); }
    return task;
  }
  if (command === "delete") {
    if (argv.length !== 2) fail("task id is required");
    const flags = options(argv.slice(2));
    if (flags.size) fail("unexpected flag");
    const task = taskById(database, argv[1]);
    database.tasks = database.tasks.filter((candidate) => candidate !== task);
    save(database);
    return { deleted: task.id };
  }
  if (command === "stats") {
    const flags = options(argv.slice(1));
    if (flags.size) fail("unexpected flag");
    const open = database.tasks.filter((task) => task.status === "open").length;
    return { total: database.tasks.length, open, done: database.tasks.length - open, overdue: database.tasks.filter((task) => task.status === "open" && task.due !== undefined && task.due < today()).length };
  }
  fail(`unknown command: ${command}`);
}

try {
  process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(run(process.argv.slice(2))) + "\n");
} catch (error) {
  process.stderr.write(`${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}\n`);
  process.exitCode = 1;
}
# Taskboard CLI

A dependency-free task manager for Bun. Tasks are stored in `.taskboard.json` in
the current directory, or in the path specified by `TASKBOARD_FILE`.

```sh
bun run src/cli.ts add --title "Write docs" --tags work,writing --due 2026-09-10
bun run src/cli.ts list --status open --tag work
bun run src/cli.ts done 1
bun run src/cli.ts stats
bun run src/cli.ts delete 1
```

Every invocation emits one JSON value on success. Errors are written to stderr
and return a non-zero exit status.
